reason: I already order kids' stuff through an Instagram page I know, I send the link on WhatsApp and they handle it. 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 pair of shoes is a lot for me, and I'd have to find things on Taobao myself, which I've never done.
objection: Paying up front to a new page I've never heard of, and then the shipping cost on top when it arrives. My page is cheaper or at least I'm used to it and I know they deliver.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or relative ordered from them and got their stuff on time, and the fees came out lower than my page for the same item.
